summary: From openly-accessible data ONLY (CT.gov registry + PubMed abstracts, no full text), we rebuilt 3 canonical T2D CVOT meta-analyses. All 3 pooled point estimates reproduce the published value to 2 decimals — validating that registry+abstract fusion + our pooling core produces the same science. Head-to-head on 3 axes below. Truth-first: we do NOT beat these exemplary MAs on completeness and say so.

method.detail: REML+HKSJ+PI is more principled, but at k=3 HKSJ (t_2) over-widens to [0.769-1.036] crossing 1 — an honest small-sample cost, not a clear win. Our naive-DL reproduces their interval.

completeness.detail: matched the 3-trial set exactly; did not exceed

transparency.detail: 3/3 datapoints source-linked (CTGOV field / abstract span), pipeline re-runnable

method.detail: adds HKSJ small-sample correction + a prediction interval [0.744-1.028] that honestly shows the class benefit is not guaranteed in every future setting; published gave point CI only

completeness.detail: matched the 7-trial set exactly; all 7 recovered from REGISTRY alone

method.detail: published used a FIXED-effect Mantel-Haenszel OR (assumes homogeneity, no PI); we model tau^2 (=0 here, confirming homogeneity) and give a prediction interval — strictly more information, same null conclusion

completeness.detail: matched the placebo-controlled CVOT set (SAVOR/EXAMINE/TECOS/CARMELINA); excluded CAROLINA (active comparator) as the benchmark did

transparency.detail: 4/4 source-linked (2 registry HR incl. EXAMINE point+upper-bound variance derivation; 2 abstract-verified spans), re-runnable

tally.method_more_advanced: 2/3 clear win (GLP-1, DPP-4) + 1 nuanced (SGLT2 k=3 HKSJ over-widens)
tally.data_completeness_beat: 0/3 (all TIE) — HONEST LIMITATION: these CVOT MAs are exemplary and already complete; we matched but did not exceed their trial sets
tally.transparency_beat: 3/3 WIN — 14/14 (100%) trial datapoints source-linked + whole pipeline re-runnable, vs published report-only process-reproducibility ~3.2% (landscape figure)

honest_caveats: Completeness: we did NOT beat these MAs — they are high-quality and complete. The completeness LEVER (registry non-publication recovery ~35-40% from the main pilot; living-MA extension as newer CVOTs post results) applies to the majority of MAs that are NOT this rigorous, but we did not manufacture a win where none exists.

The deterministic regex mis-grabbed the CANVAS renal HR (0.60) and the SAVOR on-treatment HR (1.03) instead of the primary MACE HR — errors CAUGHT and corrected only because every value carries a readable source span (the transparency invariant in action). Correct primary MACE HRs (CANVAS 0.86, SAVOR 1.00) were used, abstract-verified.

HKSJ at k=3 (SGLT2) yields a wide, non-significant CI. This is arguably MORE honest (k=3 cannot support a tight interval) but costs nominal significance vs the published DL interval — reported both ways.
